ops.insert: High Court drama - Liberty seeks urgent interdict (BREAKING)

attributes.@sum01: Hundreds of protesters gathered outside Middelburg High Court as Liberty Coal seeks interdict. Community opposes exclusion from Optimum turnaround strategy. EFF and ANC support protesters. Municipal Manager Mandla Mnguni served with papers.

ops.insert: Liberty Coal applies for interim interdict - armed protesters alleged

attributes.@sum01: Liberty Coal filed urgent application seeking interdict. Company alleges protesters brandished high-calibre semi-automatic weapons and wore balaclavas. Claims armed intimidation and unlawful blockade of operations. Director Ulrich Bester states judicial intervention is only remedy.

ops.insert: Mining dispute exposes political fault lines in Mpumalanga

attributes.@sum01: Police accused of standing by while armed protesters blocked access. Four separate gathering notices submitted between Dec 2025 and Jan 2026. Municipal councillors allegedly attended gatherings. Liberty warns constitutional right to assemble being used for unlawful conduct.

ops.insert: Community accuses Liberty of dissolving stakeholder forum

attributes.@sum01: Steve Tshwete Community Forum says Liberty dissolved stakeholder engagement forum without consultation. Community march held Jan 13 in Pullenshope. Forum demands involvement in decisions about employment, business, skills development. Liberty appointed LMS as contractor without consulting community.
